k swept 2-10 on silhouette, Davies-Bouldin, Calinski-Harabasz and the elbow; disagreement reported openly.

Maximum gap over a uniform null is 1.924. A positive gap means the data is genuinely more clustered than featureless noise spanning the same range; a gap near zero at every k would mean there is no segment structure to find.
Bootstrap ARI 0.9273 over resampled subsets; a partition that dissolved would be rejected.
Four algorithms with different cluster definitions; best pairwise ARI 0.4817.
